Advocating and collaborating for hematology
EHA serves as the face and voice of hematology and hematology professionals in Europe.
Our key activities
Raising awareness of hematology as an innovative medical discipline and its specific needs.
Developing and advocating positions on issues of interest to EHA members.
Building partnerships and alliances.
Contributing to the shaping and implementation of EU policies and legislation.
Ensuring involvement of hematologists in relevant regulatory processes and (cross-disciplinary) scientific networks.
Our stakeholder engagement
To promote the interests of our members in policy, regulatory and scientific areas and networks, EHA engages with:
EU institutions
Patient organizations
Medical societies
Other relevant bodies
Our advocacy priorities
EHA’s advocacy priorities reflect what our members consider most important:
Affordable and equitable access to innovative therapies
Support for hematology research (EU funding and research policies)
Better regulation (oriented towards clinical and patient needs and benefits)

We’re committed to accelerating progress in hematology by promoting collaboration, education, and research across all levels.
An important way of achieving this is through the careful and selective allocation of grants and funding to aspiring scientists and researchers.
